verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH/terminal client for host management, and repository or pull-request insight is a source-control axis outside its product category. Its only AI feature turns plain-language descriptions into shell commands, which is not a conversational agent for repositories or PRs, so it does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can converse with an AI agent in natural language to get insights into repositories and open pull requests
